meanings.usage: 指一种高速的小型船只
指突然改变方向的动作
描述极度的焦虑或绝望状态
标记水域位置或危险的漂浮物体
形容规模、程度或数量非常大
描述引擎或风等发出的响亮声音
指因失望或担忧而产生的情绪
指随风或水流缓慢移动
形容数量或程度较大但不是最大

examples.en: The driver swung the car round to avoid the obstacle.
examples.zh: 司机急转弯避开障碍物。

examples.en: The button came away from my coat when I caught it on the door.
examples.zh: 我衣服上的扣子被门刮掉了。

examples.en: The drowning man waved desperately to the people on the shore.
examples.zh: 溺水的人拼命向岸上的人挥手。

examples.en: The ship struck a buoy in the fog.
The airplane moved in a circle before landing.
examples.zh: 飞机在着陆前绕了一圈。

examples.en: A big wave came straight towards us.
examples.zh: 一个大浪直朝我们冲过来。

examples.en: The train roared past the station without stopping.
examples.zh: 火车轰鸣着驶过车站，没有停。

examples.en: They managed to swim out of danger before the boat returned.
examples.zh: 他们在船返回之前设法游出了危险区。

examples.en: The car slowed down as it approached the crossroads.
examples.zh: 汽车接近十字路口时放慢了速度。

examples.en: We've used up all the milk.

phrases.usage: /ˈstɪərɪŋ wiːl/ noun. 方向盘，舵轮（控制车辆或船只方向的装置）
/ˈwɔːtə skiː/ verb. 滑水（指穿着滑雪板在水上滑行）

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作或状态 用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时

examples.en: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown into the sea.
examples.zh: 两个人还没来得及意识到发生了什么，就被猛地抛入海中。

examples.en: They had just begun to swim when they noticed the speedboat was moving in a circle.
examples.zh: 他们刚开始游泳，就注意到快艇正在绕圈移动。

grammar.title: had just enough time to
grammar.structure: had just enough time to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 刚刚有足够的时间做某事 强调时间勉强足够，含有紧迫感

examples.en: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
examples.zh: 他们刚刚有时间游出危险区，快艇就又绕了一圈。

grammar.title: Before long
grammar.structure: Before long, + 主语 + 动词...
grammar.definition: 不久，很快 用于描述不久之后发生的事情，语气较正式

examples.en: Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently.
examples.zh: 不久，声音完全消失，小船开始轻轻漂流。

patterns.pattern: Both + 主语 + had + 过去分词 + when + 过去时态句子

original.en: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
original.zh: 两个人几乎没时间意识到发生了什么，就被猛地抛入海中。

imitations.en: Both students had finished the exam when the bell rang.
imitations.zh: 铃声响起时，两个学生已经答完试卷了。

imitations.en: Both tourists had lost their way when it started to rain heavily.
imitations.zh: 天开始下大雨时，两个游客已经迷路了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + had just + 过去分词 + when + 过去时态句子

original.en: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
original.zh: 他们刚刚有时间游出危险区，快艇就又绕了一圈。

imitations.en: She had just closed the door when the telephone rang.
imitations.zh: 她刚关上门，电话就响了。

imitations.en: The children had just sat down when the teacher entered the classroom.
imitations.zh: 孩子们刚坐下，老师就进了教室。

patterns.pattern: Before long, + 主语 + 动词

original.en: Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
original.zh: 不久，声音完全消失，小船开始在水面上轻轻漂流。

imitations.en: Before long, the storm stopped and the sun came out.
imitations.zh: 不久，暴风雨停了，太阳出来了。

imitations.en: Before long, he realized his mistake.
imitations.zh: 不久，他就意识到了自己的错误。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词 + in + 时间段

original.en: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
original.zh: 不到一分钟，它就在几英尺外呼啸而过。

imitations.en: In two hours, we reached the destination.
imitations.zh: 两个小时后，我们到达了目的地。

imitations.en: In a few seconds, the light went out.

lines.en: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.
lines.zh: 当那人试图让快艇转弯时，方向盘脱手了。

lines.en: He waved desperately to his companion, who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.
lines.zh: 他绝望地向他的伙伴挥手，他的伙伴在过去的15分钟里一直在滑水。

lines.en: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
lines.zh: 他们两个还没来得及意识到究竟发生了什么事情，就被猛地抛入了海里。

lines.en: The speedboat had struck a buoy , but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
lines.zh: 快艇撞上了一个浮标，但它仍在水面上快速行驶着。

lines.en: Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore, when they noticed with dismay that the speedboat was moving in a circle. It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed.
lines.zh: 两个人刚开始向岸边游去，就突然惊愕地发现快艇正在转着圈行驶，它现在正以惊人的速度直冲他们驶来。

lines.en: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
lines.zh: 不到1分钟的工夫，它从离他们只有几英尺远的地方呼啸着驶了过去。

lines.en: After it had passed, they swam on as quickly as they could because they knew that the boat would soon return.
lines.zh: 快艇过去之后，他们以最快的速度向前游去，因为他们知道快艇马上就要转回来。

lines.en: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
lines.zh: 他们刚刚来得及游出危险区，快艇就又转完了一圈。

lines.en: On this occasion , however, it had slowed down considerably .
lines.zh: 然而这一次它的速度慢多了。

lines.en: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
lines.zh: 没过多久，噪音便彻底消失，快艇开始在水面上慢悠悠地漂流。

questions.a: The speedboat was out of control and kept circling back towards the two men at tremendous speed, nearly hitting them.
questions.aZh: 快艇失控了，不停绕圈全速朝那两人冲回来，几乎撞到他们。
questions.hint: 答案见课文第5—6句：快艇撞上浮标后仍绕圈，以惊人的速度直冲他们驶来。

questions.q: What happened to the steering wheel as the man tried to swing the speedboat round?
questions.zh: 当那人试图让快艇转弯时，方向盘怎么了？
questions.a: The steering wheel came away in his hands.
questions.aZh: 方向盘在他手中脱落了。
questions.hint: 答案见第1句的 came away in his hands。

questions.q: Why did the speedboat keep moving after it struck a buoy?
questions.zh: 快艇撞上浮标后为什么还在继续行驶？
questions.a: Because it continued to move very quickly across the water with nobody controlling it.
questions.aZh: 因为它无人操控，仍在水面上快速行驶。
questions.hint: 答案见撞击浮标后那句 continued to move very quickly。

questions.q: Why did the boat finally slow down and stop circling?
questions.zh: 快艇最终为什么慢下来、不再绕圈？
questions.a: Because the petrol had nearly all been used up.
questions.aZh: 因为汽油几乎已经用光了。
questions.hint: 答案见倒数第2句 The petrol had nearly all been used up.

questions.q: What does the author's repeated use of hardly…when and just…when add to the story?
questions.zh: 作者反复使用 hardly…when 和 just…when，为故事增添了怎样的效果？
questions.a: These structures compress the events into split seconds, making the men's escape seem even narrower and more breathless.
questions.aZh: 这些结构把事件压缩在转瞬之间，使两人的脱险显得更加千钧一发、令人屏息。
questions.hint: 思考课文多次出现 had hardly had…when / had just begun…when 的用意。

translation:
当那人试图让快艇转弯时，方向盘脱手了。
他绝望地向他的伙伴挥手，他的伙伴在过去的15分钟里一直在滑水。
他们两个还没来得及意识到究竟发生了什么事情，就被猛地抛入了海里。
快艇撞上了一个浮标，但它仍在水面上快速行驶着。
两个人刚开始向岸边游去，就突然惊愕地发现快艇正在转着圈行驶，它现在正以惊人的速度直冲他们驶来。
不到1分钟的工夫，它从离他们只有几英尺远的地方呼啸着驶了过去。
快艇过去之后，他们以最快的速度向前游去，因为他们知道快艇马上就要转回来。
他们刚刚来得及游出危险区，快艇就又转完了一圈。
然而这一次它的速度慢多了。
汽油几乎已经用光。
没过多久，噪音便彻底消失，快艇开始在水面上慢悠悠地漂流。
title: Out of control
subtitle: 失控

lead.question: 两人驾快艇出海，方向盘脱手之后他们遭遇了怎样的危险？
lead.warmup: 想象一下：你和同伴在海上滑水，快艇却突然失控——方向盘脱手、快艇撞上浮标，随后船身打着转、以惊人的速度朝你冲来。本课作者只用一页文字，就把这场生死追逐写得令人屏息。学完后你会发现，正是 hardly…when 和 just…when 这类结构，让惊险的时间点一个接一个，读起来格外紧凑。
goals: 掌握 out of control、come away、use up 等短语，理解标题“失控”的含义
熟练运用过去完成时，尤其是 hardly…when / just…when 表示“刚……就……”的结构
区分 violently、wildly 等副词，准确描写动作的猛烈与失控程度
学会用 swing、roar past、drift 等动词还原海上惊险一幕
lead.summary: 课文讲两名男子乘快艇出海滑水：快艇转弯时方向盘突然脱手，两人随即被抛入海中。失控的快艇撞上浮标后并未停下，反而绕圈全速冲回，从他们身边呼啸而过。两人拼命向岸边游，刚脱险船又转完一圈，但这一次速度明显放慢，因为汽油几乎被耗尽。噪音最终消失，快艇缓缓漂流，危险随之化解。
lead.tips: hardly…when 与 just…when 中，主句用过去完成时、when 从句用一般过去时，表示“刚要……就……”；hardly / just 位于助动词之后，切勿把 when 从句也写成完成时。

exercises.q: 汉译英：当那人试图让快艇转弯时，方向盘脱手了。
exercises.a: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.
exercises.note: swing…round 使转弯；come away 脱落

exercises.q: 用 hardly…when 合并：They realized what was happening. At that moment they were thrown violently into the sea.
exercises.a: They had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
exercises.note: 主句过去完成时，when 从句一般过去时

exercises.q: 填空并说明理由：Both men were thrown ___ into the sea.（violently / wildly）
exercises.a: violently；强调被猛烈、粗暴地抛入海中，wildly 多指失去控制地狂乱地。

exercises.q: 改错：Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violent into the sea.
exercises.a: 把 violent 改为 violently，修饰动词 were thrown 应用副词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：汽油几乎已经用光了。
exercises.a: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
exercises.note: use up 用完，用被动语态

exercises.q: 填空：They had just had ___ time to swim out of danger. The water was ___ warm, but not warm enough.（enough / fairly）
exercises.note: enough 可放名词前，fairly 修饰肯定词

exercises.q: 用 just…when 改写：They had enough time to swim out of danger. At that moment the boat again completed a circle.
exercises.a: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.

quiz.q: 标题 Out of control 中 out of 表示什么意思？
options: 失去，欠缺
来自，出自
在……之外
离开某地
quiz.note: out of work 失业，out of sight 看不见

quiz.q: “方向盘在他手中脱落了”应如何表达？
options: The steering wheel came out in his hands.
The steering wheel came down in his hands.
The steering wheel came away in his hands.
The steering wheel came off his hands.
quiz.note: come away 脱落，固定搭配

quiz.q: hardly…when 结构中，主句通常用什么时态？
options: 一般现在时
过去完成时
一般将来时
现在完成时
quiz.note: hardly 主句用过去完成时

quiz.q: 哪一句正确表达“汽油几乎已经用光”？
options: The petrol had nearly all used up.
The petrol nearly all had been use up.
The petrol had been nearly all using up.
The petrol had nearly all been used up.
quiz.note: use up 用被动完成时

quiz.q: 快艇撞上浮标后仍快速移动的直接原因是什么？
options: It continued to move quickly with no one controlling it.
It was pushed by the wind towards the shore.
The men were still water skiing behind it.
The steering wheel had come back in place.
quiz.note: 失控后无人操控仍快速行驶

quiz.q: “没过多久，噪音便彻底消失”应如何表达？
options: Before long, the noise dropped down completely.
Before long, the noise dropped completely.
Long before, the noise was dropped completely.
Before long, the noise was dropped completely.
quiz.note: drop 不及物，表减弱、消失
